meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查 Codex 与 LazyCodex 安装,揪出过时或损坏的配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你用 LazyCodex 或 Codex,想确认本地安装健康、与最新版一致。
copy.tagline_en: Check Codex and LazyCodex installs for drift, staleness, or breakage.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and worry your local install may be unhealthy or outdated.

howto.what: 它会检查你本地的 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 安装，与最新源码对比，输出 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告，每条结论都注明依据的命令输出或文件。只诊断，不改动你的配置、安装和仓库。
howto.when: 当你要求 doctor 或健康检查，提到 LazyCodex 等关键词，或在安装/更新/改配置后觉得 Codex 行为异常时触发。

say.text: 帮我跑一次 LazyCodex 健康检查
我的 Codex 更新后行为不正常，帮我诊断
say.note: 检查安装与最新源码的差异

say.text: 检查我的 LazyCodex 版本是不是过期了

howto.what_en: It checks your local LazyCodex and Codex CLI install, compares it with the latest sources, and returns a PASS/WARN/FAIL report where each verdict cites its evidence. Diagnosis only — it doesn't change your config or install.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a doctor or health check, mention LazyCodex or similar keywords, or when Codex acts oddly after an install, update, or config change.

say_en.text: Run a LazyCodex health check for me
My Codex behaves oddly after an update — diagnose it
say_en.note: Compares your install against the latest sources

say_en.text: Check whether my LazyCodex version is stale
